rule: This file is the single source of truth for constants and names. To change a value or a name, change it here first; canon_check.py then lists every file that must follow. A push is blocked while a LIVE file disagrees.

dG_ATP.source: cellular ATP hydrolysis free energy (54 kJ/mol)

M_cell.source: defined without ln2; the Landauer-unit value M/ln2 = 30.2 is given separately

M_cell_Landauer.units: Landauer units (k_B T ln2 per bit)
M_cell_Landauer.source: conversion only; not a second definition

E_hold_meth.derivation: ln((1-eps)/eps) of the held error per interior opportunity on single molecules, mean over 56 healthy cell types (SD across types 0.12 kT)
E_hold_meth.source: Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/doors/data/DEV_CHAIN_Q2_01/holding_energy_q2.json (holding_energy_q2.py; chain Stage Q2 counts of 153 healthy samples, 56 cell types)
E_hold_meth.note: the instrument-corrected upper value 3.77 kT (ENCODE) was computed on the earlier counter and is not carried; it is to be recomputed on this counter

phi.units: fraction of one ATP per held bit
phi.source: Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/doors/data/DEV_CHAIN_Q2_01/holding_energy_q2.json (holding_energy_q2.py; chain Stage Q2 counts of 153 healthy samples, 56 cell types)

eps0_meth.derivation: 1/(1+exp(phi*M_cell)) with phi*M_cell = E_hold_meth = 3.084 kT MEASURED from cells' held error: the HEALTHY REFERENCE held error (not the floor). The form is physics (Boltzmann), the height is measured; about half of healthy cell types hold better than it
eps0_meth.source: Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/doors/data/DEV_CHAIN_Q2_01/holding_energy_q2.json (holding_energy_q2.py; chain Stage Q2 counts of 153 healthy samples, 56 cell types); a physics-only height (phi derived from the writer's discrimination measured outside the cell) is open

Normal_band.note: IAM-A has no healthy band of its own yet and does not borrow this one (author 2026-10-15; manifest COM-IAMA-054). Set by hand 2026-10-01 and confirmed on healthy arrays; to be rebuilt from the measured spread (OTH-059).

beta_m.derivation: beta_m = Omega_m/2 with Omega_m = 0.3153 (Planck 2018 TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing 68 % limits, Aghanim et al. 2020 Table 2; the best fit is 0.3158); value used in every Level 2 chain

Met_A_floor_EPIC_neutrophil.derivation: mean over 6 purified healthy EPIC neutrophil arrays (Salas, GSE110554; GSE167998 re-deposits the same 6 arrays) of the mean H(beta) over 6000 identity sites, our Stage 1
Met_A_floor_EPIC_neutrophil.source: chain/Runtime Matrices/Met_A_Floors/metA_floors_v1_3.json (frozen 2026-10-01); held-out precision (sites re-chosen on the other 5 arrays): SD 0.020, 0.983-1.045 (metA_floors_v1_3_loo.csv)
Met_A_floor_EPIC_neutrophil.generated: read from the frozen file by build_all; never hand-edited

Met_A_floor_450K_neutrophil.derivation: pending: v1.2 rebuild from purified 450K neutrophils (GSE88824, 8 donors)

Met_A_site_rule.value: across-array SD <= 0.05; own mean beta 0.75-0.95 (methylated) or 0.05-0.25 (unmethylated); <= 3,000 sites per channel, most stable first

P_neutrophil_IAM_A.derivation: mean over 3 granulocyte donors of the published sequencing atlas of H(eps of the other donors)/H(eps0), WHOLE files (1.1396-1.1554, CV 1.2 %)
P_neutrophil_IAM_A.source: chain/Runtime Matrices/IAM_A_Positions/iama_positions_v2.json (frozen 2026-10-08, whole files); valid for the loyfer_pat_v1 pipeline only
P_neutrophil_IAM_A.status: retired (2026-10-17): the position form of IAM-A; development flag only

H_ref_cell.derivation: H(eps0_meth): the healthy reference height, where healthy cells actually hold their methylated sites (56 healthy cell types)
H_ref_cell.source: Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/doors/data/DEV_CHAIN_Q2_01/holding_energy_q2.json (holding_energy_q2.py; chain Stage Q2 counts of 153 healthy samples, 56 cell types)

H_min_cell.derivation: H(1/(1+exp(M_cell))): the floor, where thermal kicks win against one full ATP per site (held error 8.1e-10)

IAM's law.definition: Every irreversible transition from quantum superposition to classical record pays k_B T ln 2 per bit to the nearest encoding surface at the local temperature.
IAM's law.note: The performance-floor relationship of the device gauges is named the IAM floor.

M number (M).definition: The drive ratio: drive energy over the thermal noise quantum, M = E_drive/(k_B T). Sets the operating regime; for a record held in a gap hf, M = hf/(k_B T) and its thermal floor is 1/(1+e^M). Cell: 20.94 (30.2 in Landauer units). Chips: M = E_sw/(k_B T_j) = A x ln 2 (chip gauge). The only quantity named 'Mahaffey'. Named like the Mach number: a ratio to a natural scale (drive over k_BT, as Mach is speed over the speed of sound). Not named after a person (author, 2026-10-24).

IAM floor.definition: Synonym of H_min (the floor): the lowest error a system can hold at its temperature before thermal kicks win.

Informational fidelity ratio (A).definition: A = reading / the same system's healthy reading (the healthy reference), measured on the same instrument. Dimensionless; A = 1 is the system working as itself, in the middle of the gauge. Below it lies H_min, the lowest error the system can hold before thermal kicks win; nothing reads below H_min. Above 1 = more error than healthy. Cells: Met-A = mean H(beta) over identity sites / the healthy reference (purified healthy cells, same platform); IAM-A = H(eps)/(P_cell H(eps0)). Qubits: eps/eps(as built), eps = -ln(1-p). Chips: E_sw/E_sw(as built). A is never the temperature exponent n.
Informational fidelity ratio (A).note: One meaning of A in every domain: the reading over the healthy or as-built reading of the same system. For qubits the gate error in nats is epsilon = -ln(1-p_2Q); A is epsilon over the device's as-built value.

Landauer metrology.definition: Measuring how far above its thermal floor an information-writing process operates, against a fixed physical zero, in any substrate.

the methylation report.definition: The biological (genetic) application of IAM's law: the umbrella for every cellular and organismal chain. Expansion as in Issue 002: Genomic Analytical & Performance Engine. Chains under it: MethylPhys CPG (methylation, cells), the salmonid chain (in development).

MethylPhys CPG.definition: The cell instrument: Methylation Physics, Cellular Performance Gauge. Reads cells' methylation (Met-A, IAM-A) and places them on the gauge.

Salmonid chain.definition: The cell instrument applied to salmonids: IAM-A per fish and tissue at water temperature. Not a cellular performance gauge.

Met-A (Metrology A).definition: Array reading of ONE cell type in one specimen (chain Stage M): Met-A = mean over the cell's identity sites of H(beta) / H_ref(cell), H(b) = -b log2 b - (1-b) log2(1-b). H_ref(cell), the healthy reference (the gauge's middle mark, healthy = 1; not the floor H_min) = the same quantity on purified healthy cells of the same type on the same platform, through the chain's own Stage 1 (constant Met_A_floor_EPIC_neutrophil; site rule Met_A_site_rule); >= 90 % of the identity sites must be measured. Whole blood: the denominator is the composition-matched healthy expectation mean_i H(sum_c f_c mu_c,i), with the specimen's own fractions f (Stage A, EPIC blood NNLS) and purified healthy profiles mu (no group comparison; PROC-WB-NEUT-01); read at any neutrophil fraction with its own detection limit (DEV-LOWFRAC-01; no fixed fraction cut). Stage T tare: against >= 3 healthy references run the same way (same slide, else same batch), A_rel = A / median(reference A); with >= 20 reference records the noise-corrected tare A = a + b f_neu + c N (N = noise index, mean H(beta) over 48,528 fixed sites; DEV-NOISE-02). The gauge state is printed on A_rel only; without references the reading is reported as untared. Each reading carries its detection limit (smallest loss of the cell's pattern the specimen could show). Commissioned 2026-10-09 on isolated neutrophils, EPIC v1; whole blood is read and printed with the note that it has not yet been tested with Met-A; 450K and EPIC v2 refused. Normal 0.95-1.05. Information theory only; no energy content. Expansion: Informational Metrology A score.

IAM-A.definition: Error reading on single-molecule sequencing, each sample against its own reference: IAM-A = eps / eps_pred(L). eps is the held error (isolated unmethylated calls between two methylated calls, over the interior calls of qualifying molecules: at least 6 calls, at least 80 % held), counted by chain Stage Q2; L is the sample's own loose share (share of 2,000-CpG tiles held below 70 %); eps_pred(L) = 0.040265 + 0.034625 L is the healthy self-reference line, measured once on 153 healthy samples of 56 cell types (chain/Runtime Matrices/IAM_A_SelfRef/selfref_line_v1.json). No other specimen is a reference. Normal band v1: 0.779-1.055 (band_v1.json). Before reading, the sample-shape check declines a sample whose tile distribution is outside the healthy shape of its cell type (shape_reference_v1.json). Ends on the gauge are the sample's own: full surface 0.5/eps_pred(L) (12.42 at L = 0, 6.68 at L = 1). Commissioned 2026-10-17 on healthy blood CD8 T cells, whole-genome bisulfite sequencing (COMMISSIONING_NOTE_IAMA.md); other cell types are read and printed with the note that they have not yet been tested with IAM-A. The earlier position form, H(eps)/(P_cell H(eps0)), is retired (development flag only).

Salmon-A.definition: Not a separate quantity: IAM-A read by the salmonid chain (body temperature = water temperature).

EPLG.definition: Error Per Layered Gate (IBM): the average error per gate across a 100-qubit chain running layered circuits, including crosstalk and idle errors. It is NOT the same quantity as an isolated median two-qubit error p(2Q) and must not be compared with one.

C-score (sky-map C-score).definition: Clustering of a specimen's residual sky map on the Met-A identity sites: c = var(sqrt(10) x the means of 10 consecutive sites in genome order) / var(z), over the site variance; C = c / c_healthy, c_healthy = 1.0103 (leave-one-out median of the six reference arrays; neutrophil_reference_v1_2.json), so healthy reads 1 on the same gauge as A. Read one-sided against the healthy band 0.877-1.152 after the same-run tare (above 1.152 is a clustered departure). Commissioned 2026-10-15 on whole blood, EPIC v1 (COMMISSIONING_NOTE_CSCORE.md). Chain v4 also draws the map on a HEALPix sphere (NSIDE 128, nested order) in the report; nothing is scored from the drawing. A cosmology map statistic, not a physics floor. On first use in papers write 'sky-map C-score'. Blocks of 50 and baseline 1.1104 were the construction before 2026-10-09.

H_min (cell).definition: In the cell chain, the floor a reading is divided by. For Met-A: the cell type's reference floor on that platform (Met_A_floor_*), one per cell type, from purified healthy cells - never a class value. For IAM-A: P_cell * H(eps0), the physics floor's entropy at the cell's frozen architecture position P_cell (same read-level pipeline).
H_min (cell).replaced_by: H_min (the floor) for the physics floor; Healthy reference for the denominator

H_min (the floor).definition: The absolute lowest error a system can hold before thermal kicks win; below it the system no longer exists as itself. It is NOT the denominator of A and NOT 1: it sits below 1 at H_min / healthy reference. Cells: thermal kicks win against one full ATP per site, held error 1/(1+e^M) = 8.1e-10, H_min = 2.5e-8 bits (1e-7 on the IAM-A gauge, 8e-8 on Met-A, neutrophils). It is NOT the healthy reference height H_ref = H(eps0) = 0.2593 bits. Qubits: the thermal floor p_eq t_g/T1, p_eq = 1/(1+exp(hf/(k_B T))) at the temperature the qubit's record sees. Chips: the Landauer floor k_B T_j ln 2.
H_min (the floor).note: The absolute lowest point a system can operate at before thermal kicks win.

eps (gate error in nats).definition: eps = -ln(1 - p(2Q)), the two-qubit gate error expressed in nats; eps ~ p for small p. It is the qubit reading; A = eps / eps(as built).

One gauge (convention).definition: Every score is an error score on one gauge: A = 1 is healthy in the middle, H_min below it is the floor nothing passes, above 1 is more error; a failure point may lie on the high side (qubits: error correction fails near p = 1 %). Each domain keeps its field's form. Always quote a value with its score's name.
One gauge (convention).note: Adopted 2026-10-02: each domain is read with its own physics, so the formulas are not forced to be identical.

Healthy reference.definition: The denominator of A: the same system's healthy reading on the same instrument. Cells: Met-A, the purified healthy cells of that type on that platform (EPIC neutrophils 0.330263 bits; constant name Met_A_floor_* kept for the chain until the SOP rename); IAM-A, the sample's own predicted held error eps_pred(L) from its own loose share (commissioned 2026-10-17; no other person enters; the earlier P_cell H(eps0) form is retired). Devices: the device as built.

Thermal floor (qubit).definition: The qubit H_min and the left-hand mark of the qubit gauge: IAM's Law at the temperature the record sees. p_eq = 1/(1+exp(hf/(k_B T))) for the held record; p_eq t_g/T1 for one gate of duration t_g (detailed balance).

H_ref (healthy reference height).definition: Cells: where healthy cells actually hold their methylated sites, H(eps0) = 0.2593 bits (E_hold 3.084 kT, measured per interior opportunity across 56 healthy cell types; about half hold better than it). Measured, not a limit; the floor is H_min. The distance from H_min to H_ref in energy is phi = 0.1473 of one ATP.

IAM-Atlas v2.1.definition: The reference map of 79 purified healthy human cell types: 813,951 sites, built from 21 public array and sequencing sources fitted as one Bayesian model, so every site carries a best value and a 95 % range. Commissioned use by use (COMMISSIONING_NOTE_ATLAS_V21.md). Published: fitted atlas 10.5281/zenodo.23441999; 100 posterior draws per block 10.5281/zenodo.23422688.

IAM-Deconvolver.definition: Reads which blood cells are in a sample and in what shares (chain Stage D21), against IAM-Atlas v2.1's six-cell blood panel; commissioned on the mean share error (0.016, bar 0.03) in a laboratory it never saw.

Group-A.definition: The group instrument (chain stage_groupa.py, commissioned 2026-10-20): each person's whole-blood Met-A, tared against healthy arrays of the same run, and the two groups' tared means compared (difference, standard error, t). Groups must be run in the same series.

Tare (same-run tare).definition: Dividing a reading by the median of at least 3 healthy references run the same way (same slide, else same series), so a laboratory's offset cancels: A_rel = A / median(A_refs). Met-A, the C-Score and Group-A use it.

Sky sphere (address sphere).definition: The globe layout every IAM map uses: every atlas site in genome order placed on HEALPix NSIDE 256, NESTED order, site i of n at pixel floor(i x NPIX / n) (atlas/tools/sky_maps_v21.py; frozen for the chain in sky_order_v21.npz). A site's place is its genome address; the information is in the color. Benefits: equal-area pixels, no edges, change along the genome shows as patches, and the sky's tools (masks, nulls, maps with uncertainty) apply.

Information sphere.definition: In development (DEV-SPHERE-01): a globe on which a site's place comes from how it behaves, not where it sits. Each methylation level b maps to the point (sqrt b, sqrt(1-b)) on a circle of radius 1, and the distance between two states is the Fisher-Rao angle; the whole methylome lies on one high-dimensional sphere. Not adopted until its construction passes its sealed bars.

Globe Explorer.definition: The site's page of interactive globes (IAM-Atlas v2.1 first; Met-A's purified-array reference; example samples; noise maps), drawn by the chain's one viewer (globe_viewer.py), the same code as every report's globe. Pictures, not readings: nothing is scored from a globe.

Noise map (posterior draws).definition: The atlas's uncertainty shown as its own pictures: the average of the first k of a cell's 100 posterior draws at every site (k = 1, 2, 4 ... 100, draws taken in turn from the four sampling chains); the map settles onto the atlas's value as k grows (atlas/tools/noise_maps_v21.py).

Anchor range (preliminary).definition: A whole-blood reading of the span between an array's low and high fixed-site anchors, tared on its slide, that keeps a loss spread evenly over every site, which Met-A's self-tare cancels (GRP-014, DEV-SELFTARE-03). Preliminary: read and flagged, not commissioned.

Hard-to-map probes.definition: EPIC v1 probes whose sequence matches the genome with mapping quality under 10 or not at all (3.14 % of the array). Removing them moves no IAM instrument beyond its own repeat noise (DEV-MAPPABILITY-01, OTH-079); IAM-A's read counter already drops reads with mapping quality under 10.

scope.record_files_note: Published editions, provenance scripts and verbatim records: kept as written, never edited to current language. 2026-10-19: dated records of the earlier held-error counter (every CpG in the denominator) keep the values they were sealed or written with; PROC_CHANNEL_01_OUTCOME.md carries the correction. 2026-10-20: the 18th chain's raw sampler output is data, not prose; number patterns match only a whole number (never digits inside a longer one). 2026-10-24: day logs, MANIFEST.md (generated from the manifest's dated notes) and DEV_SPECIES_AGEING_01.md (sealed record) keep the name 'Mahaffey number' as written; live text says 'the M number'.

cell_scope.rule: The chain reports Met-A, IAM-A and both C-scores for neutrophils only until commissioned with new VALs; cell types are added one at a time, in order of abundance in blood, each after passing healthy-in-Normal, known-2%-damage detection and same-person repeat (author, 2026-10-01).
